title: A lookup to a record the viewer cannot read prints the raw id ("CTPnPnOW17jcvcy-" with a question mark) — show "Restricted record" instead (hotcrm#2194 R2-T1-U02)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 查找字段指向当前用户无权读取的记录时，页面直接显示记录 ID（如知识文章 KA-0025 的来源工单显示「CTPnPnOW17jcvcy-」）。
- **要做：** 显示「受限记录」（或不带链接的标签），不显示 ID。
- **完成标准：** 无权读取的查找值不再显示原始 ID。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **R2-T1-U02**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** knowledge article KA-0025, na.rep (HotCRM).
- **Now:** Source Case reads "CTPnPnOW17jcvcy-" with a question-mark icon (the case GET answers 404 for the rep).
- **Cost:** an id is meaningless to a user and looks like broken data.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [round 2 track 1 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/dda91814dfe304ec48e616f5886491ecd7e8ade3/qa/2026-10-20-v18-full/REPORT.md), U-02; [`66-KB-005-helpful-vote.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/dda91814dfe304ec48e616f5886491ecd7e8ade3/qa/2026-10-20-v18-full/shots/66-KB-005-helpful-vote.png).

## Landing

- The console's lookup display (field cell and record page) when the referenced record's read answers 404 / not readable. It must not reveal more than the id did: no title fetch around the reader's authority.

## Done when

- A lookup to an unreadable record shows "Restricted record" (translated), with no link and no id, on the record page and in grids.
- A readable lookup renders as today; tests for both.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectui issue (24) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (185, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `lookup`, `restricted`, `raw id`, `cannot read`. 7 hits, all closed lookup-picker defects (#13310, #13271, #13162, #13123 and others). Not this display. **New.**
